MemAPIKeyCredential.title: Mem API Key
MemAPIKeyCredential.x-credential-instructions: In Mem settings, open the API section and copy your API key. Paste the key alone; NoClick sends it using Bearer authentication to api.mem.ai.

MemAddNoteToCollectionConfig.description:
Add an existing note to an existing collection.
This operation only creates the membership link and does not modify note or collection content.
Use create endpoints to create notes or collections.

collection_id.description: UUID of the collection that will receive the note. Use an ID returned by create/list/search. The caller must be able to contribute to this collection.
collection_id.title: Collection Id

note_id.description: UUID of the note to add. Use an ID returned by create/list/search. The caller must be able to access this note.
note_id.title: Note Id

MemAddNoteToCollectionConfig.title: MemAddNoteToCollectionConfig

MemCreateCollectionConfig.description:
Create a collection with optional caller-provided ID and timestamps.
If `id` already exists, this request returns a conflict.
Use collection membership endpoints to add, remove, or move notes between collections.

created_at.description:
Optional creation timestamp (ISO 8601).
If provided, it must include a timezone offset and cannot be in the future.
If omitted, Mem uses `updated_at` when provided; otherwise current server time.
created_at.title: Created At

description.description:
Optional longer description of collection scope or intent.
Maximum: 10,000 characters (and no more than 10,000 UTF-8 bytes).
description.title: Description

id.description:
Optional caller-provided UUID for the collection.
If omitted, Mem generates a new UUID.
If the provided ID already exists, this request returns a conflict.
id.title: Id

title.description:
Title for the collection.
Use a short, stable label suitable for navigation and search.
Maximum: 1,000 characters (and no more than 1,000 UTF-8 bytes).
title.title: Title

updated_at.description:
Optional "last updated" timestamp for this write (ISO 8601).
If provided, it must include a timezone offset and cannot be in the future.
If omitted, Mem uses `created_at` for the initial collection write.
updated_at.title: Updated At

MemCreateCollectionConfig.title: MemCreateCollectionConfig

MemCreateNoteConfig.description:
Create a note with an optional note ID, timestamps, and collection links.
If omitted, Mem generates the note ID.
The first line of `content` becomes the note title.

collection_ids.description:
Optional collection IDs to associate with the note.
IDs that do not map to accessible collections are ignored.
collection_ids.title: Collection Ids

collection_titles.description:
Optional collection titles to associate with the note.
Matching is case-insensitive exact match; titles with no match are ignored.
Maximum per title: 1,000 characters (and no more than 1,000 UTF-8 bytes).
collection_titles.title: Collection Titles

content.description:
Full markdown body for the note.
Send the full desired note body (partial patch semantics are not supported here).
IMPORTANT: The first line is interpreted as the note title.
Maximum: 200,000 characters (and no more than 200,000 UTF-8 bytes on create).
content.title: Content

created_at.description:
Optional creation timestamp (ISO 8601).
If provided, it must include a timezone offset and cannot be in the future.
If omitted, Mem uses `updated_at` when provided; otherwise current server time.
created_at.title: Created At

id.description:
Optional UUID for the note.
If omitted, Mem generates a new UUID.
id.title: Id

updated_at.description:
Optional "last updated" timestamp for this write (ISO 8601).
If provided, it must include a timezone offset and cannot be in the future.
If omitted, Mem uses the current server time for the initial content write.
updated_at.title: Updated At

MemCreateNoteConfig.title: MemCreateNoteConfig

MemDeleteCollectionConfig.description:
Permanently delete a collection.
Hard-deleting removes the collection resource itself.
For membership-only changes, use note add, remove, or move collection endpoints.

collection_id.description: UUID of the collection to permanently delete. Use an ID returned by create/list/search. The caller must be able to access this collection.
collection_id.title: Collection Id

MemDeleteCollectionConfig.title: MemDeleteCollectionConfig

MemDeleteNoteConfig.description:
Permanently delete a note.
Hard-deleted notes cannot be restored.
For recoverable removal, use `POST /v2/notes/{note_id}/trash`.

note_id.description: UUID of the note to permanently delete. Use an ID returned by create/list/search. The caller must be able to edit this note.
note_id.title: Note Id

MemDeleteNoteConfig.title: MemDeleteNoteConfig

MemFindRelatedNotesConfig.description:
Find notes semantically related to the current persisted content of a note.
The source note is embedded at request time, so newly created or recently
updated notes can be used before asynchronous indexing catches up.
Candidate related notes still come from the note search index.

limit.description:
Maximum number of related notes to return.
Default is 10; valid range is 1 to 20.
limit.title: Limit

note_id.description: UUID of the source note. The caller must be able to access this note.
note_id.title: Note Id

MemFindRelatedNotesConfig.title: MemFindRelatedNotesConfig

MemGetCollectionConfig.description:
Fetch metadata for a single collection by ID.
This endpoint returns collection metadata only, not a note list for that collection.
For discovery flows, use `GET /v2/collections` or `POST /v2/collections/search`.

collection_id.description: UUID of the collection to read. Use an ID returned by create/list/search. The caller must be able to access this collection.
collection_id.title: Collection Id

MemGetCollectionConfig.title: MemGetCollectionConfig

MemGetNoteConfig.description:
Fetch the full current state of a single note by ID.
If the note is in trash, the response still returns the note and includes `trashed_at`.
For discovery flows, use `GET /v2/notes` or `POST /v2/notes/search`.

note_id.description: UUID of the note to read. Use an ID returned by create/list/search. The caller must be able to access this note.
note_id.title: Note Id

MemGetNoteConfig.title: MemGetNoteConfig

MemListCollectionsConfig.description:
List collections visible to the authenticated caller with cursor pagination.
Results are ordered by `order_by` and return `next_page` when additional rows are available.
For relevance-ranked retrieval by query, use `POST /v2/collections/search`.

limit.description:
Maximum number of collections in this page.
Use smaller values for lower latency.
Default is 50; valid range is 1 to 100.
limit.title: Limit

page.description:
Opaque cursor from a previous list response.
Omit for the first page.
IMPORTANT: Reuse with the same filters and `order_by` settings.
page.title: Page

order_by.description:
Sort key for pagination boundaries.
Use `updated_at` (default) for recency feeds.
Use `created_at` for creation-order views.
order_by.title: Order By

filter_by_created_after.description:
Optional inclusive lower bound for collection creation time (ISO 8601).
The timestamp must include a timezone offset such as `Z` or `+01:00`.
filter_by_created_after.title: Filter By Created After

filter_by_created_before.description:
Optional inclusive upper bound for collection creation time (ISO 8601).
The timestamp must include a timezone offset such as `Z` or `+01:00`.
filter_by_created_before.title: Filter By Created Before

filter_by_updated_after.description:
Optional inclusive lower bound for collection update time (ISO 8601).
The timestamp must include a timezone offset such as `Z` or `+01:00`.
filter_by_updated_after.title: Filter By Updated After

filter_by_updated_before.description:
Optional inclusive upper bound for collection update time (ISO 8601).
The timestamp must include a timezone offset such as `Z` or `+01:00`.
filter_by_updated_before.title: Filter By Updated Before

MemListCollectionsConfig.title: MemListCollectionsConfig

MemListNotesConfig.description:
List notes visible to the authenticated caller with cursor pagination.
When multiple `contains_*` fields are true, a note may match any of them.
Results are ordered by `order_by` and return `next_page` when additional rows are available.
For relevance-ranked retrieval by query, use `POST /v2/notes/search`.

limit.description:
Maximum number of notes in this page.
Use smaller values for lower latency.
Default is 50; valid range is 1 to 100.
limit.title: Limit

page.description:
Opaque cursor from a previous list response.
Omit for the first page.
IMPORTANT: Reuse with the same filters and `order_by` settings.
page.title: Page

order_by.description:
Sort key for pagination boundaries.
Use `updated_at` (default) for recency feeds.
Use `created_at` for creation-order views.
order_by.title: Order By

collection_id.description:
Optional collection filter by UUID.
When set, only notes linked to this collection are returned.
collection_id.title: Collection Id

filter_by_created_after.description:
Optional inclusive lower bound for note creation time (ISO 8601).
The timestamp must include a timezone offset such as `Z` or `+01:00`.
filter_by_created_after.title: Filter By Created After

filter_by_created_before.description:
Optional inclusive upper bound for note creation time (ISO 8601).
The timestamp must include a timezone offset such as `Z` or `+01:00`.
filter_by_created_before.title: Filter By Created Before

filter_by_updated_after.description:
Optional inclusive lower bound for note update time (ISO 8601).
The timestamp must include a timezone offset such as `Z` or `+01:00`.
filter_by_updated_after.title: Filter By Updated After

filter_by_updated_before.description:
Optional inclusive upper bound for note update time (ISO 8601).
The timestamp must include a timezone offset such as `Z` or `+01:00`.
filter_by_updated_before.title: Filter By Updated Before

contains_open_tasks.description:
When true, include notes that contain at least one open task item.
When multiple `contains_*` fields are true, notes matching any selected
filter may be returned.
contains_open_tasks.title: Contains Open Tasks

contains_tasks.description:
When true, include notes that contain at least one task item
(open or closed).
When multiple `contains_*` fields are true, notes matching any selected
filter may be returned.
contains_tasks.title: Contains Tasks

contains_images.description:
When true, include notes that contain image media
(including image and GIF kinds).
When multiple `contains_*` fields are true, notes matching any selected
filter may be returned.
contains_images.title: Contains Images

contains_files.description:
When true, include notes that contain file-like attachments
(including file and PDF kinds).
When multiple `contains_*` fields are true, notes matching any selected
filter may be returned.
contains_files.title: Contains Files

include_note_content.description:
When true, include full markdown content for each returned note.
IMPORTANT: This increases payload size and can increase latency.
include_note_content.title: Include Note Content

MemListNotesConfig.title: MemListNotesConfig

context.description:
Additional background information that helps Mem understand how this input relates to your existing knowledge.

Examples:
• "This is related to my Project Alpha research"
• "This is from the quarterly planning meeting"
• "This is a follow-up to our discussion yesterday"

Maximum of ~10k characters.
context.title: Context

input.description:
Any raw content you want to remember - web pages, emails, transcripts, articles, or simple text.

Common Use Cases:
• HTML from a webpage
• Email text (including headers)
• Meeting transcript
• Text from a document
• Simple notes or thoughts

Examples:
• "<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><title>AI Trends 2025</title>...</html>"
• "[08:47:19] Kevin: Hello...[09:15:22] Meeting ended."
• "Check out Atomic Habits by James Clear - recommended by Sarah"

Maximum of ~1M characters (~1 MB).
input.title: Input

instructions.description:
Optional guidance on how you want this information processed or remembered.

Examples:
• "Extract the key findings and save as a research note"
• "Create a summary with action items and decisions"
• "Add to my reading list"

Maximum size: approximately 10 KB.
instructions.title: Instructions

timestamp.description:
When this information was encountered or created (ISO 8601 datetime string). Defaults to the current date and time.

Example:
• "2025-04-01T14:30:45Z"
• "2023-12-15T09:45:30+01:00"

Maximum of ~10k characters.
timestamp.title: Timestamp

MemMoveNoteConfig.description:
Move a note from one collection to another collection.
This operation adds the note to the target collection, then removes it from the source collection.
It does not modify note or collection content.

source_collection_id.description: UUID of the collection that currently contains the note. Caller must be able to remove the note from this collection.
source_collection_id.title: Source Collection Id

note_id.description: UUID of the note to move. Use an ID returned by create/list/search.
note_id.title: Note Id

target_collection_id.description:
UUID of the collection that should receive the note.
The caller must be able to add the note to this collection.
target_collection_id.title: Target Collection Id

MemMoveNoteConfig.title: MemMoveNoteConfig

MemRemoveNoteFromCollectionConfig.description:
Remove a note from a collection while keeping both resources.
This operation only removes the membership link between IDs.
Use note/collection deletion endpoints to remove resources.

collection_id.description: UUID of the collection to unlink. Use an ID returned by create/list/search. Caller must be able to edit the note or contribute to the collection.
collection_id.title: Collection Id

note_id.description: UUID of the note to unlink. Use an ID returned by create/list/search. Caller must be able to edit the note or contribute to the collection.
note_id.title: Note Id

MemRemoveNoteFromCollectionConfig.title: MemRemoveNoteFromCollectionConfig

MemRestoreNoteConfig.description:
Restore a previously trashed note to the active note set.
This only reverses soft-delete lifecycle state.
Notes permanently deleted via `DELETE /v2/notes/{note_id}` cannot be restored.

note_id.description: UUID of the note to restore from trash. Use an ID returned by create/list/search. The caller must be able to edit this note.
note_id.title: Note Id

MemRestoreNoteConfig.title: MemRestoreNoteConfig

MemSearchCollectionsConfig.description:
Search collections using free-text relevance matching.
Returns a bounded relevance-ranked result set and does not return `next_page`.
For deterministic chronological pagination, use `GET /v2/collections`.

filter_by_created_after.description:
Optional inclusive lower bound for collection creation time (ISO 8601).
The timestamp must include a timezone offset such as `Z` or `+01:00`.
filter_by_created_after.title: Filter By Created After

filter_by_created_before.description:
Optional inclusive upper bound for collection creation time (ISO 8601).
The timestamp must include a timezone offset such as `Z` or `+01:00`.
filter_by_created_before.title: Filter By Created Before

filter_by_updated_after.description:
Optional inclusive lower bound for collection update time (ISO 8601).
The timestamp must include a timezone offset such as `Z` or `+01:00`.
filter_by_updated_after.title: Filter By Updated After

filter_by_updated_before.description:
Optional inclusive upper bound for collection update time (ISO 8601).
The timestamp must include a timezone offset such as `Z` or `+01:00`.
filter_by_updated_before.title: Filter By Updated Before

query.description:
Optional text query for relevance matching across collections.
If omitted, search can still return a bounded general set.
query.title: Query

MemSearchCollectionsConfig.title: MemSearchCollectionsConfig

MemSearchNotesConfig.description:
Search notes using a required free-text query and structured filters.
When multiple `filter_by_contains_*` fields are true, a note may match any of them.
Returns note results from a bounded search snapshot with deterministic offset pagination.
Query-based searches are relevance-ranked within the bounded search snapshot window.
Reuse the returned `snapshot_id` when requesting later pages.
The returned `total` reflects the bounded search snapshot, capped by the 100-result search window.
For deterministic chronological pagination across all accessible notes, use `GET /v2/notes`.

limit.description:
Maximum number of notes in this search page.
Use smaller values for lower latency.
Default is 20; valid range is 1 to 50.
limit.title: Limit

offset.description:
Number of matching notes to skip before returning results.
This value is zero-based.
offset.title: Offset

snapshot_id.description:
Opaque search snapshot identifier returned by a previous search page.
Required when requesting later pages with `offset > 0`.
snapshot_id.title: Snapshot Id

filter_by_collection_ids.description:
Optional collection UUID filters.
When provided, results are limited to notes in any listed collection.
filter_by_collection_ids.title: Filter By Collection Ids

filter_by_contains_files.description:
When true, include notes that contain file-like attachments
(including file and PDF kinds).
filter_by_contains_files.title: Filter By Contains Files

filter_by_contains_images.description:
When true, include notes that contain image media
(including image and GIF kinds).
filter_by_contains_images.title: Filter By Contains Images

filter_by_contains_open_tasks.description: When true, include notes that contain at least one open task item.
filter_by_contains_open_tasks.title: Filter By Contains Open Tasks

filter_by_contains_tasks.description:
When true, include notes that contain at least one task item
(open or closed).
filter_by_contains_tasks.title: Filter By Contains Tasks

filter_by_created_after.description:
Optional inclusive lower bound for note creation time (ISO 8601).
The timestamp must include a timezone offset such as `Z` or `+01:00`.
filter_by_created_after.title: Filter By Created After

filter_by_created_before.description:
Optional inclusive upper bound for note creation time (ISO 8601).
The timestamp must include a timezone offset such as `Z` or `+01:00`.
filter_by_created_before.title: Filter By Created Before

filter_by_updated_after.description:
Optional inclusive lower bound for note update time (ISO 8601).
The timestamp must include a timezone offset such as `Z` or `+01:00`.
filter_by_updated_after.title: Filter By Updated After

filter_by_updated_before.description:
Optional inclusive upper bound for note update time (ISO 8601).
The timestamp must include a timezone offset such as `Z` or `+01:00`.
filter_by_updated_before.title: Filter By Updated Before

query.description:
Required text query for relevance matching.
The query must contain at least one non-whitespace character.
This endpoint does not provide exhaustive chronological pagination; for that, use
`GET /v2/notes`.
query.title: Query

MemSearchNotesConfig.title: MemSearchNotesConfig

MemSetNoteCreatedAtConfig.description:
Set a note's visible creation timestamp without changing its content.
The supplied `created_at` must include a timezone offset and cannot be in the future.
It can only backdate the note: the timestamp cannot be later than
when the note was originally created.
This operation changes note metadata only.
Trashed notes must be restored before their creation date can be changed.

note_id.description: UUID of the note whose visible creation timestamp should change. The caller must own this note.
note_id.title: Note Id

created_at.description:
New visible creation timestamp for the note (ISO 8601).
It must include a timezone offset and cannot be in the future.
It can only backdate the note: the timestamp cannot be later than
when the note was originally created.
This changes note metadata only; it does not update note content.
created_at.title: Created At

MemSetNoteCreatedAtConfig.title: MemSetNoteCreatedAtConfig

MemTrashNoteConfig.description:
Soft-delete a note by moving it to trash.
Trashed notes can be restored via `POST /v2/notes/{note_id}/restore`.
For irreversible deletion, use `DELETE /v2/notes/{note_id}`.

note_id.description: UUID of the note to move to trash. Use an ID returned by create/list/search. The caller must be able to edit this note.
note_id.title: Note Id

MemTrashNoteConfig.title: MemTrashNoteConfig

MemUpdateCollectionConfig.description:
Update metadata for a collection by ID.
Use this endpoint to rename a collection by setting `title`.
This endpoint updates only provided fields (`title`, `description`) and leaves omitted fields unchanged.
For read-only retrieval, use `GET /v2/collections/{collection_id}`.

clear_description.description: Clear the collection description. Sends an empty description to Mem.
clear_description.title: Clear Description

collection_id.description: UUID of the collection to update. Use an ID returned by create/list/search. The caller must be able to edit this collection.
collection_id.title: Collection Id

description.description:
Optional replacement description for the collection.
Omit to keep the current description unchanged.
Set to an empty string to clear the description.
Maximum: 10,000 characters (and no more than 10,000 UTF-8 bytes).
description.title: Description

title.description:
Optional replacement title for the collection.
Use this field to rename a collection.
Omit to keep the current title unchanged.
Maximum: 1,000 characters (and no more than 1,000 UTF-8 bytes).
title.title: Title

updated_at.description:
Optional "last updated" timestamp for this write (ISO 8601).
If provided, it must include a timezone offset and cannot be in the future.
If omitted, the current server time is used.
updated_at.title: Updated At

MemUpdateCollectionConfig.title: MemUpdateCollectionConfig

MemUpdateNoteConfig.description:
Submit a complete markdown body for a note and the exact `version` being updated.
Send the full desired body in `content` (not a partial markdown patch).
The first line of `content` becomes the updated title.
Trashed notes must be restored before they can be updated.

note_id.description: UUID of the note to update. Use an ID returned by create/list/search. The caller must be able to edit this note.
note_id.title: Note Id

content.description:
Complete markdown body to submit for this write.
Send the full desired note body (partial patch semantics are not supported
in this request payload).
The first line is interpreted as the title.
content.title: Content

updated_at.description:
Optional "last updated" timestamp for this write (ISO 8601).
If omitted, the current server time is used.
updated_at.title: Updated At

version.description:
Exact note content document version this update is based on.
Use the `version` returned by `GET /v2/notes/{note_id}` or by the most
recent note write response.
version.title: Version

MemUpdateNoteConfig.title: MemUpdateNoteConfig

credentials.description: Credentials for this node (optional if using environment variables)
